review.reference: Review passed: Android bridge follows existing chat broadcast pattern (BroadcastAction/BroadcastEvent/LocalBroadcastManager/BroadcastReceiver). Constants SEND_CUSTOM_XMPP_COMMAND and CUSTOM_XMPP_EVENT match iOS WP04 character-for-character. Both are exposed via getConstants() so JS resolves ExternalAPI.* keys. JitsiMeetView.sendCustomXmppCommand accepts @Nullable action/targetId/payload with sensible defaults. No new files created (5 modified files, all in owned path). Host->JS path: sendCustomXmppCommand -> LocalBroadcastManager -> existing BroadcastReceiver -> ReactInstanceManagerHolder.emitEvent -> JS middleware. JS->host path: RN middleware -> ExternalAPIModule.sendEvent -> BroadcastEmitter.sendBroadcast -> LocalBroadcastManager -> host app listener. No listener interface exists in this Android codebase (events flow via BroadcastEvent); implementer correctly mirrored the chat broadcast pattern instead of the iOS listener delegate pattern. Build verification (gradle assembleDebug / lintDebug) skipped due to no Android build cache; reviewers on developer workstation should re-run NFR-004 lint baseline before merge.
